title: Obtain business licenses and operating permits
summary: Before starting an activity or opening a location that may require permission. A jurisdiction-and-activity register showing issued permissions, unresolved restrictions and renewal owners.
outcomes: A jurisdiction-and-activity register showing issued permissions, unresolved restrictions and renewal owners.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before starting an activity or opening a location that may require permission.

parts.title: List activities, products and operating locations
parts.guidance: Describe what the business actually does, where staff and customers are located, the premises used and any regulated products. Include online and physical activities so a company registration is not mistaken for an activity permit.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Determine the competent authorities and requirements
parts.guidance: Have a qualified local adviser identify the relevant licensing bodies and assess exemptions, prerequisites and restrictions. Record the authority source and current requirements for the actual activity; leave uncertain permissions unresolved.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Determine the competent authorities and requirements

parts.title: Prepare a permission-by-permission application pack
parts.guidance: Assemble the required entity, premises, personnel, insurance and product evidence from verified records. Track missing documents and dependencies without inventing qualifications, approvals or eligibility.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Submit the approved applications and track decisions
parts.guidance: The authorized applicant reviews the final declarations and fees, submits through the authority channel and retains receipts. Respond to requests through the assigned owner and keep the restricted activity paused while a required permission is pending.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Submit the approved applications and track decisions

parts.title: Release permitted activities and calendar renewals
parts.guidance: Check the issued license scope, conditions, location and expiry against the intended operation. Assign renewal and change-notification owners and retain evidence of the decision to start each permitted activity.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Release permitted activities and calendar renewals

verify.how: A jurisdiction-and-activity register showing issued permissions, unresolved restrictions and renewal owners.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
